questions.question: How do you optimize vector search indexing latency for high-dimensional embeddings?
questions.answer: I use Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) graphs with Product Quantization (PQ) to reduce memory overhead and enable approximate nearest neighbor search under 10ms SLA.

questions.question: What trade-offs exist between Cosine Similarity and L2 Euclidean Distance when normalizing dense vectors?
questions.answer: Cosine similarity measures angular alignment regardless of vector magnitude, making it ideal for text embeddings. L2 distance considers magnitude, which requires normalized unit vectors.

questions.question: How do you handle schema evolution and index rebalancing under heavy concurrent write traffic in ChromaDB?
questions.answer: I implement write-ahead logging (WAL) and memory buffers to stage incoming vectors before flushing to persistent segment files asynchronously.
